reason: The golden fixture was seeded at git f0f7c67 and the DEFAULT ScenarioConfig identity has moved many times since (FF-1F/FF-2A/FF-2C default flips + several added fields), so a fresh solve of REFERENCE_SCENARIO_KWARGS no longer reproduces the seeded cache key. Recorded by the forecast-readiness audit 2026-07-30 as FR-26 (`the stale golden fixture causes no red anywhere ... and has no staleness expiry`). This waiver is what makes that staleness LOUD and time-bounded instead of invisible. RE-ISSUED 2026-08-02 rather than RESOLVED (see `reissue_2026_08_02`): the owner's signed disposition is to move the fixture OFF ERCOT before reseeding anything, and that move is separate scoped work needing its own signed 15-solve-year seed authorization.
authorization_route: Reseeding is a 15-solve-year invocation and is therefore owner-authorized work: docs/forecast-readiness-audit-2026-07.md §4 Phase 2, decision D-7 (`Golden-fixture reseed authorization ... and weather-year posture for eventual goldens`). No session may reseed on its own initiative (scripts/golden_forecast_bands.py REGEN_POLICY + §2.1b). THE 2026-08-02 SIGNATURE DID NOT GRANT THIS: the owner signed the waiver RE-ISSUE only. Seeding a golden on ANY ISO remains an unauthorized 15-solve-year invocation over the §2.1b 5-year cap, and golden_forecast_bands.py's schedulability guard will refuse without its own written authorization.
on_expiry: tests/regression/test_golden_forecast_bands.py::test_golden_fixture_config_identity_is_current FAILS. Resolve it by executing D-7 (reseed with `golden_forecast_bands.py seed --force --reason ... --full-solve-authorized`, delete this file) or by re-issuing the waiver with a new expiry and a recorded owner decision. Do NOT delete the test.

reissue_2026_08_02.owner_decision: D-7(i) — RE-ISSUE THE WAIVER, THEN MOVE IT OFF ERCOT. Signed 2026-08-02; record: docs/handoffs/ffr-owner-sitting-2026-08-02.md Addendum C.1 (row D-7(i)) and C.2. This was NEITHER option the decision packet offered (AUTHORIZE reseed / HOLD): the owner challenged the packet's premise, the manager verified rather than defended, and the challenge held on every count — the third resolution is the one this file's own `on_expiry` clause already named.
reissue_2026_08_02.expiry_is_adjustable: YES — the owner signed the RE-ISSUE, not this date. 2027-01-31 is FFR-3B's proposal, chosen only as ~6 months of runway for the off-ERCOT move plus its own seed-authorization sitting. Change it freely; nothing downstream keys on the value, and the only consumer is the date comparison in test_golden_fixture_config_identity_is_current.
reissue_2026_08_02.why_reissued_not_resolved: Resolving means reseeding, and the fixture is to be MOVED OFF ERCOT FIRST. ERCOT is the least-settled anchor of the six: it is ABSENT from the `complete` block of frontend/data/backcast/calibration-complete.json (while NEISO/NYISO/PJM are in it), its keeper carries DETERMINATION NOT-YET with fail set {C3a, C3b, C3c, C7}, and it churns keepers near-daily (ercot149 -> ercot150b during the sitting alone) — which is a large part of WHY this fixture keeps going stale. Reseeding on ERCOT today buys a fixture that re-stales on the next keeper. NEISO is the named target (holds a `complete` marker; cheapest measured lane, ~4.0-4.2 GB peak vs ERCOT plant-level 5.9 GB). CLAUDE.md's 'the calibrated reference' for ERCOT means most-developed lane, not marker-holding.
reissue_2026_08_02.the_move_is_separate_scoped_work: NOT covered by this signature and NOT startable from it. `iso="ERCOT"` is hardcoded in REFERENCE_SCENARIO_KWARGS and both golden filenames are hardcoded, so the move is a code change, not a flag. It needs (a) its own scoped session and (b) its own SIGNED 15-solve-year seed authorization under forecast-development-plan §2.1b. Recorded here so no later session reads 'move it off ERCOT' as pre-authorized.
verified_facts_do_not_re_derive: tests/regression/test_golden_forecast_bands.py::test_golden_bands_hold — the 15-solve-year band check — is @pytest.mark.slow AND skipped unless RUN_GOLDEN_FORECAST=1. It runs NOWHERE automatically.
ci.yml's ONLY reference to tests/golden/** is a path filter. No CI job solves the golden.

test_golden_fixture_config_identity_is_current — the test this waiver actually holds off — is a pure config-hash comparison (hashes ScenarioConfig(**REFERENCE_SCENARIO_KWARGS), compares to seeded_cache_key). It builds NO LP. The consequence of expiry is one cheap test going red, not a blocked pipeline.

One count where the challenge did NOT hold, recorded for honesty: the fixture already sets use_campd_bins=False explicitly to bound runtime, so it is NOT running ERCOT's 1,458-generator plant-level config. The SPEED case for switching ISOs is weak; the CALIBRATION case is the strong one.
reissue_2026_08_02.not_authorized_by_this_reissue: A reseed, on ERCOT or any other ISO. Explicitly withheld — sitting C.5: 'Not authorized by anything here: the golden reseed invocation'. Deleting the test is likewise forbidden: this file's on_expiry clause says so and the owner's disposition repeats it.
